title: The Small Premium for Convenience
short_teaser: Customers may pay more when a service saves time, reduces uncertainty, or removes effort.
story: Customers may pay more when a service saves time, reduces uncertainty, or removes effort. Value is not limited to the object delivered. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust through the decisions beneath the visible offer. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Value is not limited to the object delivered. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust through the decisions beneath the visible offer.
spark_application: Apply the lesson to one customer, offer, process, or decision. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
